text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak received a report of the results of the Asian tour by Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri. The report said the trip opened new horizons for foreign investment in Egypt and gave Asian countries the message that Egypt is ready to absorb more investments.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said there was no sign of any step in the Middle East peace process.
- EgyptAir chairman Mohamed Fahim Rayyan said that 10 new planes would join the EgyptAir fleet this year at a cost of $1.2 billion. The state will not contribute to the financing.
- The cabinet meeting on Saturday will discuss Ganzouri's Asian tour and the sale of more shares in state companies.
- An interview with President Hosni Mubarak will be broadcast on Friday morning on the Good Morning Egypt programme.
- The clocks go forward one hour at 11 p.m. this evening at the start of summer time.
- Mubraka met Manpower and Employment Minister Ahmed el-Amawi and the head of Trade Union Federation, Sayyed Rashed, and discussed with them workers' problems.
